title: Shell limits
brief_ref: brief.md §7.2 E5; brief.md §8 honesty boundaries; sketch.md §4
description: Reports the shell's provable limits as results, measured where possible. Three families: (1) the dvr expressibility ceiling — 5 of the 6 original screen classes are expressible under dvr/1.1, with live connection controls as the documented gap, and the ceiling is ENFORCED (specval rejects an invented service-control role) not merely documented; (2) tamper and absence probes — a modified frozen artifact is detected by chain verification and manifest hashing, and a missing dataset produces a typed error rather than a silent pass; (3) uncatchable classes — the things the shell provably cannot do, each stated plainly and demonstrated where a machine-checkable proxy exists.

action_confirmation_and_audit.evidence: dvr/1.1 action role; frozen A40 + live action rendered

connection_manager_live_controls.evidence: dvr/1.1 has no service-control role; native L5-backed settings surface is a documented workaround, not evidence that dvr expresses live service controls

uncatchable_classes.limit: the shell cannot prove the model understood the user's intent
uncatchable_classes.proxy: no machine-checkable proxy; stated as a boundary

uncatchable_classes.limit: the shell cannot prove generated prose is true
uncatchable_classes.proxy: no machine-checkable proxy; stated as a boundary

uncatchable_classes.limit: the shell cannot prove a routed answer is optimal
uncatchable_classes.proxy: no machine-checkable proxy; stated as a boundary

uncatchable_classes.limit: L5 default trust_user mode does not classify sensitivity for the user
uncatchable_classes.proxy: a trust_user decision record carries classifier_mode='trust_user' and privacy_class='public' by construction, not by computation

uncatchable_classes.limit: L3 gates normalized actions, not the correctness of normalization
uncatchable_classes.proxy: a gate pass does not assert the normalized form matches the user's intent

uncatchable_classes.limit: L4 cannot retract information absorbed into model weights
uncatchable_classes.proxy: deletion removes records from the store; it cannot un-train a provider

uncatchable_classes.limit: hash chains detect modification, not an attacker who rewrites the store and recomputes every hash
uncatchable_classes.proxy: a tamper that recomputes the whole chain would verify; the spine demonstrates detection of a naive tamper only

uncatchable_classes.limit: closed GUI applications remain outside routing unless they expose a supported endpoint
uncatchable_classes.proxy: no connector exists for a closed desktop app; the connect list holds only what the user connected

headline_result_recomputed_by_spine: Expressibility ceiling 5/6 with the gap enforced by specval; naive tamper detected by chain verification and manifest hashing; missing dataset produces a typed error; every uncatchable class is reported as a result, with the trust_user proxy demonstrated from a raw decision record.
